decisive_items: a 25‐mm pericecal collection adjacent to surgical clips
response.rationale: The CT finding of a pericecal collection adjacent to surgical clips, combined with prior appendectomy and systemic inflammation, strongly indicates a post-surgical abscess. Other candidates are less specific or contradicted by the surgical history.

rejected.why: No diverticula described; collection adjacent to clips favors surgical complication.
Appendiceal abscess is inaccurate because the appendix was removed; the collection is a post-surgical abscess.
Appendicitis is excluded by prior appendectomy.
Leukocytosis with neutrophilia, not neutropenia; no immunosuppression.
Diverticulitis is less likely given the surgical clips and location; collection is more consistent with abscess.
Too broad; does not capture the specific post-surgical nature.
